About us

Puerto Plata Cruise Excursions is a local tour operator in Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic. We pick up cruise passengers at Amber Cove and Taíno Bay, plan the day around the ship’s schedule and look after you in English and Spanish.

  • Pickup at Amber Cove and Taíno Bay
  • 6 tours from US$12 per person
  • Service in English and Spanish
  • Book on WhatsApp: +1 (829) 627-7733
  • Book by email: popcruiseexcursions@gmail.com

    Private catamaran or yacht

    Charter the whole boat just for your group and sail the Puerto Plata coast. Choose from 4 catamarans and 2 yachts.

    Boats leave from Sosúa beach, 45 minutes from Amber Cove port and 30 minutes from Taíno Bay. You can add round-trip transport from the port: its price, by group size, is below.

    Price for the whole boat, not per person: only your group on board, for 4 hours. Snorkeling is included on every boat.

    Subject to availability: before paying, message us on WhatsApp or by email to confirm the boat is free on your date.

Is your ship docking at Amber Cove or Taíno Bay?

We pick you up at both Puerto Plata cruise ports. See what you can do from yours and how long it takes to reach each tour.

  • Amber Cove On Maimón Bay, about 15–20 minutes from downtown. Mostly Carnival Corporation ships. Amber Cove shore excursions
  • Taíno Bay Right in downtown Puerto Plata, next to the San Felipe Fortress. Royal Caribbean, Celebrity, Norwegian, MSC and other lines. Taíno Bay shore excursions

Frequently asked questions

What every cruise passenger asks before booking.

We pick you up at the Puerto Plata cruise port and bring you back when the tour ends. Round-trip transport is included in every other tour; for catamarans and yachts it’s optional: they leave from Sosúa beach, 45 minutes from Amber Cove port and 30 minutes from Taíno Bay, and you can add the transport when you book, priced by group size.

Yes. We pick you up at whichever port your ship docks at, Amber Cove or Taíno Bay, and bring you back when the tour ends. We confirm the exact meeting point on WhatsApp or by email when you book. For catamarans and yachts, transport to Sosúa is optional and priced by group size.

Your cruise itinerary says so. In general, Amber Cove receives Carnival Corporation ships (Carnival, Princess, Holland America…) and Taíno Bay receives Royal Caribbean, Celebrity, Norwegian, MSC and other lines. Tell us your ship’s name when you book and we’ll check.

We plan every tour around your ship’s departure time. When you book, tell us your ship’s name and your all-aboard time.

The price per person depends on how many of you travel together: 1 to 2, 3 to 5, 6 to 14 or 15 to 50 people. The bigger the group, the less each person pays. Buggies and ATVs are priced per vehicle, and cost less from 3 vehicles on. Catamarans and yachts work differently: you charter the whole boat for a flat price for up to 15 or 20 people, depending on the boat, and each additional person costs extra.

Round-trip transport, water along the way and a buffet lunch at the waterfalls’ restaurant. The zipline is optional.

No. At the end of the tour you get free time at Playa Dorada, where you can have lunch at one of the beachfront restaurants if you like. Lunch and extra drinks are not included.

English and Spanish. Message us on WhatsApp or by email in whichever language you prefer.

A swimsuit, a towel and sunscreen; shoes that can get wet if you’re going to Damajagua; some cash in US dollars for tips and shopping; and your cruise card plus a photo ID to get back on board.

Cancel 10 or more days before your tour and we refund 100% of what you paid; with less than 10 days’ notice, we refund 50%. If your cruise ship doesn’t reach Puerto Plata, we refund 90%.

You book with a deposit via PayPal, Zelle or Cash App: 50% of the total for the tours, and a fixed amount for catamarans and yachts (shown in each boat’s details). You pay the rest in person on the day of the tour. For the tours, you can also pay the full price in advance.
